fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "A Century of Weather Tinkering", "body": "Chance opens on the Frankenskies clip in which Lyndon Johnson says that he who controls the weather controls the world, and Matt, who says years of street activism taught him to read people, sees open malice in the delivery. He then walks back to a rainmaker named Hatfield, hired by a drought-stricken San Diego, who Matt says sprayed chemicals from a tower and flooded the region. From there he explains cloud seeding with silver iodide and dry ice, and argues that the same military establishment spraying carbon dioxide into the skies now blames ordinary people's emissions for a warming climate."}, {"title": "Matt's Case on Fires and Spraying", "body": "Asked whether the Amazon fires could have been put out, Matt answers yes on every level and lays out his case: a story he credits to a St. Louis reporter about radioactive cadmium sprayed over poor neighborhoods, rainwater tests he says show aluminum and barium, and patents he says list those compounds as fire accelerants. In his view engineered heat and wind turn forests into tinder as part of a corralling of humanity, with chemtrails dimming the sun at the center. Chance reads that dimming as a barrier between people and source, and wonders whether fires follow indigenous land rights wins in court, a link Matt says he believes."}, {"title": "Matt on 5G, Fertility and a Hijacked Realm", "body": "Matt says the deepest layer of the agenda is 5G, which he believes will leave children raised around it unable to have children of their own. Chance pushes further, wondering whether test-tube births could open the door for non-human consciousness to take the place of human souls. Matt answers through Rudolf Steiner's Ahrimanic force, his distrust of Elon Musk's Neuralink and Mars ambitions, and a theory that Earth is a realm where souls shed karma together, one that lower vibrational beings are trying to hijack by baiting humanity, step by technological step, into consenting to its own soullessness."}, {"title": "Source, Unlearning and Frequency", "body": "Chance frames demonic consciousness as intelligence cut off from source, which is why he calls it vampiric, and ties what he sees as a dimmed sun, the food supply and the space narrative to one project of disconnection. The remedy he offers is dissolving the inner barriers of separation and building psychic immunity to lies, since true literacy now means learning to unlearn. Matt agrees from experience: a business master's degree never taught him how potatoes grow, or anything about his body or frequency. Chance's answer is grounding into the Schumann resonance, and Matt's is his Sparrow clothing line, which he says will shield pregnant women and children from EMF."}, {"title": "Becoming an Actual Activist", "body": "Matt's own awakening came late, when a friend asked him in his early thirties how he could deny chemtrails, and he says Frankenskies has since been seen by a few million people. His method is simple: hand out flyers, which he offers to send to anyone who emails, and plant truth seeds without needing to water them, because being the change changes your being. Chance adds that every artist can carry the message in their own medium. Alone afterward, Chance argues that top-down climate rules lead to tyranny, calls artificial intelligence the biggest demon humans could create, and closes on spiritual anarchy as internal sovereignty."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: When it comes to world domination, weather manipulation and control is a big piece on the chess board. The "powers that should not be" have spent decades on weather control R&D, and today's guest Matt Landman has blown the lid off these projects with his documentary Frankenskies: The Lies In The Sky Exposed. Matt is also actively seeking solutions to many other planetary crisis situations, and is currently launching an EMF protection clothing line. Get inspired by this passionate earth protector to become an actual activist, and use your art as a weapon for truth against the evil empire.
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "We have the opportunity to cultivate discernment in this empire of lies.", "author": "Matt Landman", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/83bd0d4b-138b-4737-afd8-d89c22ef4e5f/matt-landman.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's an internal connection to source that we all have which also will be what we need more than anything to transcend our current external scenario.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Technology is kind of like this virus, like it was introduced to us on our timeline before we were mature enough as a species to handle it.", "author": "Matt Landman", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/83bd0d4b-138b-4737-afd8-d89c22ef4e5f/matt-landman.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "True literacy in our modern age isn't about learning to read, it's about learning to unlearn things.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Being the change literally starts to change your being.", "author": "Matt Landman", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/83bd0d4b-138b-4737-afd8-d89c22ef4e5f/matt-landman.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's like an infinite number of ways to express and communicate the truth and it can be your way.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Meet people on their level to plant that perfect seed. You don't have to come back and water that seed or germinate it, just drop it in the dirt and trust.", "author": "Matt Landman", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/83bd0d4b-138b-4737-afd8-d89c22ef4e5f/matt-landman.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I think that artificial intelligence is like the biggest demon the humans could conjure or create.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}]
